title: The Pelvic Floor — Leaks, Pregnancy and Life After Childbirth

hook.en: Leaking urine after a cough or a jump is common but not normal, and many women never ask for help. Learn what the pelvic floor does, how to train it properly and when to refer.
hook.ur: Khansi ya chhalang par peshab ka nikalna aam hai magar normal nahi, aur bohat si khawateen madad nahi maangtin. Seekhein ke pelvic floor kya karta hai, ise sahi tareeqe se kaise train karein aur kab refer karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain the pelvic floor in plain words, teach a correct contraction with a gradual programme, adapt it for pregnancy and the weeks after birth, and recognise signs that need a doctor.
goal.ur: End tak aap pelvic floor saada alfaz mein samjhayenge, sahi contraction aur darje war programme sikhayenge, ise hamal aur paidaish ke baad ke haftay ke liye adjust karenge, aur woh nishaniyan pehchanenge jin ke liye doctor chahiye.

text.en: The **pelvic floor** is a hammock of muscles at the base of the pelvis. It **supports** the bladder, womb and bowel, helps keep the openings **closed**, and works with the deep abdominal muscles, diaphragm and back. Pregnancy and vaginal birth stretch it, and many women notice **leaking** when they cough, laugh or lift. This is **stress urinary incontinence**, and it responds very well to **pelvic floor muscle training**.
text.ur: **Pelvic floor** pelvis ke neeche muscles ka jhoola hai. Yeh mesana, bachadani aur aanton ko **sahara** deta hai, raaston ko **band** rakhne mein madad karta hai, aur gehre pait ke muscles, diaphragm aur peeth ke saath kaam karta hai. Hamal aur normal paidaish ise kheenchte hain, aur bohat si khawateen khansi, hansi ya wazan uthane par **peshab nikalna** mehsoos karti hain. Yeh **stress urinary incontinence** hai, aur **pelvic floor muscle training** se bohat achha theek hoti hai.

text.en: Think of the pelvic floor as the **bottom of a trampoline** that should be both firm and springy. When it is weak, it sags and pressure from a cough pushes things out. When it is too tight and cannot relax, it also causes problems, such as pain and difficulty emptying. Training must teach both **lift** and **let go**.
text.ur: Pelvic floor ko **trampoline ka neechla hissa** samjhein jo mazboot bhi ho aur lachakdar bhi. Kamzor ho to dheela ho jata hai aur khansi ka dabao cheezein bahar dhakel deta hai. Zyada tight ho aur dheela na ho sake to bhi masle hote hain, jaise dard aur khali karne mein mushkil. Training mein **oopar khainchna** aur **chhorna** dono seekhna chahiye.

steps.title: Ask kindly and privately
steps.detail: Ask about leaking, urgency, heaviness, pain and bowel habits in a private room, with a female colleague offered if the patient prefers. Explain why you ask and that it is common. || Narmi aur ekant mein poochhein

steps.title: Find the right muscle
steps.detail: Teach "squeeze and lift as if holding back wind and stopping the flow of urine", without holding the breath or squeezing the buttocks and thighs. Do not use stopping mid-stream as an exercise. || Sahi muscle dhoondein

steps.title: Build a programme
steps.detail: Start with short holds and a full relaxation, then lengthen the holds and add quick squeezes, several times a day, for at least three months. Add the squeeze before a cough ("the knack"). || Programme banayein

steps.title: Adapt for pregnancy and after birth
steps.detail: Train during pregnancy, avoid straining, and in the first weeks after birth start gently with breathing and light squeezes. Return to impact exercise gradually, only when there is no leaking, heaviness or pain. || Hamal aur paidaish ke baad adjust karein

question.en: Which instruction gives the best chance of a correct pelvic floor contraction?
question.ur: Kaun si hidayat pelvic floor ki durust contraction ka behtareen mauqa deti hai?

text.en: Squeeze and lift as if holding back wind, while breathing normally
text.ur: Hawa roknay ki tarah dabayein aur oopar khainchein, normal saans lete hue

feedback.en: Yes — a lift without breath holding or buttock squeezing targets the right muscles.
feedback.ur: Haan — saans roke ya kulhay dabaye baghair oopar khainchna sahi muscles ko target karta hai.

text.en: Practise stopping the urine mid-stream every time
text.ur: Har baar peshab ki dhaar darmiyan mein rokein

feedback.ur: Yeh mesane ke khali hone mein masla kar sakta hai.

text.en: Hold the breath and squeeze the buttocks hard
text.ur: Saans rok kar kulhay zor se dabayein

feedback.en: That uses the wrong muscles and raises pressure.
feedback.ur: Yeh ghalat muscles istemal karta hai aur dabao barhata hai.

title.en: Weak pelvic floor or too-tight pelvic floor?
title.ur: Kamzor pelvic floor ya zyada tight pelvic floor?

rows.en: Leaking with cough, laugh or lifting; heaviness
rows.ur: Khansi, hansi ya wazan par leaking; bojh

rows.en: Pelvic pain, pain with intercourse, slow stream, constipation
rows.ur: Pelvic dard, ta'alluq mein dard, dhaar ka dheema hona, qabz
Oopar nahi khainch pata ya hold nahi kar pata
Poori tarah dheela nahi ho pata
Mazeed mazboot karne wali squeezes shamil karna

text.en: **Lift, then let go.** A good pelvic floor contraction has two halves: a gentle lift, and a full release. Practise both, and do not hold the breath.
text.ur: **Oopar, phir chhorna.** Achhi pelvic floor contraction ke do hisse hain: halki oopar khainchna aur poori tarah chhorna. Dono ki mashq karein, aur saans na rokein.

text.en: **Giving only "do your Kegels".** A written instruction is not enough. Many women contract the wrong muscles on their first try. Check the technique (by trained assessment, or with real-time ultrasound where available) and give a simple, written programme.
text.ur: **Sirf "Kegels karo" keh dena.** Sirf likhi hidayat kaafi nahi. Bohat si khawateen pehli koshish mein ghalat muscles dabati hain. Technique check karein (trained assessment se ya jahan dastyab ho real-time ultrasound se) aur saada likha hua programme dein.

question.en: Which finding means a woman should see a doctor before training?
question.ur: Kaun si finding batati hai ke training se pehle doctor se milna chahiye?

text.en: A bulge or heaviness in the vagina with heavy bleeding or fever
text.ur: Vagina mein ubhaar ya bojh, bhari bleeding ya bukhar ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — these signs need medical assessment.
feedback.ur: Haan — in nishaniyon ko medical assessment chahiye.

feedback.en: That is a common, treatable pattern.
feedback.ur: Yeh aam aur qabil-e-ilaaj pattern hai.

question.en: When can a woman usually begin returning to running after birth?
question.ur: Paidaish ke baad aurat aam taur par daurna kab shuru kar sakti hai?

text.en: Gradually, once she has no leaking, heaviness or pain, often after about three months
text.ur: Aahista, jab leaking, bojh ya dard na ho, aksar takreeban teen mahine ke baad

feedback.en: Yes — readiness, not a fixed date, decides; build up with strength and walking first.
feedback.ur: Haan — taiyari faisla karti hai, muqarrar tareekh nahi; pehle taaqat aur chalna barhayein.

text.en: As soon as bleeding stops, with no checks
text.ur: Bleeding band hote hi, bina check ke

feedback.en: Impact too early can overload healing tissue.
feedback.ur: Bohat jaldi impact theek hote tissue par bojh daal sakta hai.

text.en: Never again after a vaginal birth
text.ur: Normal paidaish ke baad kabhi nahi

feedback.en: Most women can return with the right plan.
feedback.ur: Zyada tar khawateen sahi plan ke saath wapas aa sakti hain.

text.en: **Make it small and daily.** Link squeezes to things she already does: after passing urine, before standing up, before lifting the baby. Agree on a start date, review in four to six weeks and ask directly about leaking at each visit. Most women improve with a supervised programme.
text.ur: **Chhota aur rozana banayein.** Squeezes ko un kaamon se jorein jo woh pehle se karti hai: peshab ke baad, uthne se pehle, bachay ko uthane se pehle. Shuru ki tareekh tay karein, chaar se chhe haftay mein review karein aur har visit par leaking ke baare mein seedha poochhein. Zyada tar khawateen nigrani wale programme se behtar hoti hain.

question.en: Why can a woman who can "squeeze hard" still leak?
question.ur: Jo aurat "zor se dabati hai" woh phir bhi leak kyun kar sakti hai?

answer.en: Because strength alone is not enough. The muscle must contract at the right time, just before the pressure from a cough or lift, and it must be able to relax. Many women also squeeze the wrong muscles or hold their breath, so timing and technique need coaching.
answer.ur: Kyunke akeli taaqat kaafi nahi. Muscle ko sahi waqt par, khansi ya wazan ke dabao se bilkul pehle, contract hona chahiye aur dheela bhi hona chahiye. Bohat si khawateen ghalat muscles dabati hain ya saans rokti hain, is liye timing aur technique ki coaching zaroori hai.

beats.patient: A 32-year-old woman, three months after a vaginal birth, leaks a little urine when she coughs or runs after her toddler. She has no pain or bulge and wants to return to jogging.
beats.assessment: The picture fits stress urinary incontinence after childbirth with no red flags; a pelvic floor programme with good technique has a high chance of helping.
beats.treatment: Teach the lift and release with the knack, build the programme over twelve weeks, add trunk and leg strength, and delay jogging until the leaking settles.
beats.reassess: At twelve weeks she rarely leaks, restarts a walk-run plan and keeps the squeezes as a habit.

text.en: **Refer to a doctor** for blood in the urine, severe pelvic or abdominal pain, fever, a bulge you can see or feel, loss of bladder or bowel control with back pain or leg weakness, heavy or foul-smelling bleeding after birth, a hot, painful, swollen calf, or sudden severe headache, vision changes or swelling during or after pregnancy.
text.ur: **Doctor ko refer karein** peshab mein khoon, shadeed pelvic ya pait ka dard, bukhar, nazar aane ya mehsoos hone wala ubhaar, peeth ke dard ya taangon ki kamzori ke saath peshab ya pakhane par qaboo khona, paidaish ke baad bhari ya badboodar bleeding, garam, dardnak, soojhi hui pindli, ya hamal ke dauran ya baad mein achanak shadeed sar dard, nazar ki tabdeeli ya sujan.

summary.en: The pelvic floor supports the pelvic organs and keeps the openings closed; stress leaking is common and responds well to training.
summary.ur: Pelvic floor pelvic organs ko sahara deta hai aur raaston ko band rakhta hai; stress leaking aam hai aur training se achha theek hota hai.

summary.en: Teach a correct contraction (lift and let go, no breath holding), build a programme over at least three months and add the knack before coughing.
summary.ur: Sahi contraction sikhayein (oopar khainchna aur chhorna, saans na rokna), kam az kam teen mahine ka programme banayein aur khansi se pehle knack shamil karein.

summary.en: Return to impact gradually after birth, when there is no leaking, heaviness or pain; refer for bleeding, bulge, fever or calf pain.
summary.ur: Paidaish ke baad impact par aahista wapas aayein, jab leaking, bojh ya dard na ho; bleeding, ubhaar, bukhar ya pindli ke dard par refer karein.

back.en: Leaking urine when pressure rises, for example with a cough, laugh or lift.
back.ur: Peshab ka nikalna jab dabao barhe, maslan khansi, hansi ya wazan par.

front.en: What are the two halves of a good pelvic floor contraction?
front.ur: Achhi pelvic floor contraction ke do hisse kya hain?

back.en: A gentle lift and a full release.
back.ur: Halka oopar khainchna aur poori tarah chhorna.

back.en: Squeezing the pelvic floor just before a cough or lift.
back.ur: Khansi ya wazan se pehle pelvic floor dabana.

front.ur: Programme ko parakhne se pehle kitni der chalana chahiye?
